title.zh: 授予Charles William Mosser先生菲律宾公民身份及随之附随的一切权利、特权与优先权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Filipino Citizenship to Mr. Charles William Mosser, with all the Rights, Privileges and Prerogatives Appurtenant Thereto
title.orig: An Act Granting Filipino Citizenship to Mr. Charles William Mosser, with all the Rights, Privileges and Prerogatives Appurtenant Thereto

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2006/ra_9363_2006.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby granted a special recognition to Mr. Charles William Mosser for his long and outstanding service to the Filipino people through his involvement in developmental and socio-civic projects in the country, proving himself more than worthy to be a Filipino.
The Republic of the Philippines will be considered the permanent place of abode of Mr. Charles William Mosser to which he shall forever owe and pledge allegiance and loyalty.
Philippine citizenship is hereby granted to Mr. Charles William Mosser, with all the rights, privileges and prerogatives appurtenant thereto.
This Act shall take effect upon approval.
